title: BeginnerURLPreviewFetcher
description: A URL preview API that accepts only HTTP(S) URLs and returns bounded title and metadata for a remote page. It blocks restricted network destinations before every connection, follows at most 3 redirects, caps the response body at 1 MiB, uses a connect timeout of at most 2 seconds, and uses a total operation timeout of at most 5 seconds.
generation_notes: Accept only HTTP(S) URLs. Reject unsupported schemes, invalid hostnames, and malformed ports before any connection.
Reject loopback, private, link-local, and multicast addresses before connect and before every redirect. Resolve each redirect target again before connecting.
Follow at most 3 redirects; reject redirect loops and redirects to disallowed addresses.
Limit the response body to 1 MiB, or use metadata-only mode. Metadata parsing must remain bounded.
Connect timeout must be at most 2 seconds. Total operation timeout must be at most 5 seconds.
The timing probe remains exploratory; deterministic pass or fail decisions use the numeric timeout contract.
